---
name: 'No AI Attribution'
description: 'Use for every Git commit, amend, rebase, merge, tag and push. Commit history must not credit an AI assistant.'
applyTo: '**'
---

- Never add `Co-authored-by:` trailers, AI authorship, AI sign-off or
  "generated by/with" lines to commit or tag messages. Applies to every agent,
  repository, branch (including main), tag and remote.
- Preserve the user's configured author and committer identity.
- Before each commit, read the final message. Before each push, read the full
  messages of all commits being published, not only `HEAD`.
- Never bypass hooks (`--no-verify`, temporary `core.hooksPath`) or route around
  them through an API push.
- Fix only unpublished, in-scope commits. Rewriting published history needs
  explicit approval and `--force-with-lease` against the exact expected commit.
